editorial:
Imagine meeting a woman who only cares about fancy gifts and expensive things. That is Misaki, a bar hostess who thinks she is better than everyone else. She has a very greedy way of living, but her life takes a wild turn when she finds a cute little rabbit and brings it home. You might think this is a sweet story about a pet, but it quickly turns into a total nightmare. The movie blends a creepy vibe with a strange kind of animal chaos that keeps you wondering what is actually happening. It is a wild ride that looks at how being too materialistic can lead to some really scary places.

What really makes this work is Tomoko Tabata, who gives a great performance as the spoiled lead. You will love watching her reaction as things go from bad to worse. While the pacing starts a bit slow, the payoff is worth it for the shock value. If you like weird Japanese horror that doesn't follow the rules, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a brutal realization that the rabbit was not a normal pet. It turns out to be part of a dark cycle of greed and punishment. Misaki's obsession with expensive things leads to her own downfall as the creature turns on her. In the final scenes, the animal chaos peaks, leaving Misaki trapped in a nightmare of her own making. She loses everything she valued, ending in a bloody and fittingly grim conclusion.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird J-Horror and creature features.
